sourceSections.heading: Training
sourceSections.text: We trained our models on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs. We used batches of approximately 25,000 source tokens and 25,000 target tokens. We used the Adam optimizer with beta1 = 0.9, beta2 = 0.98 and epsilon = 10^-9. We varied the learning rate over the course of training.

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding

sourceSections.heading: BERT
sourceSections.text: BERTBASE has 12 layers, a hidden size of 768, and 12 self-attention heads. BERTLARGE has 24 layers, a hidden size of 1024, and 16 self-attention heads.

papers.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models

sourceSections.heading: Our Method
sourceSections.text: During training, W0 is frozen and does not receive gradient updates, while A and B contain trainable parameters. We apply LoRA to the weight matrices in the Transformer self-attention modules.

papers.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness

sourceSections.heading: Introduction
sourceSections.text: We present FlashAttention, an IO-aware exact attention algorithm that uses tiling to reduce the number of memory reads and writes between levels of the GPU memory hierarchy.
